entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-06-23
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • DangerousFileDetectorTests.ItShouldDetectFileWithMarkOfTheWeb fails on IE-less vs2026.pre.scout image #54951
  • MTPHelpSnapshotTests.VerifyMTPHelpOutput snapshot mismatch (--progress option added) #54948
  • Flaky test: PostActionTests.AddProjectToSolution_WithOutputRelativePath - .sln file not found #54942
  • Static Web Assets: deferred asset group resolution is not applied during publish (causes 'Sequence contains more than one element') #54940
  • .NET 10 SDK requires specific apphost pack (8.0.27) and fails when only newer runtime (8.0.28) is installed #54935

Closed

  • System.ArgumentException: Cannot delete a subkey tree because the subkey does not exist #54927

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix potential assembly mismatches for Microsoft.TestPlatform.ObjectModel #54952
  • Update MTPHelpSnapshotTests snapshot for --progress option changes #54950
  • Consolidate duplicate MSBuildUtilities copies (#51487) #54947
  • Disable Mark-of-the-Web test on IE-less Windows images (#54951) #54945
  • Restore [CombinatorialData] in dotnet-watch.Tests using Combinatorial.MSTest #54944
  • Disable parallel test execution for investigation #54943
  • Static Web Assets: apply deferred asset group resolution during publish #54941
  • POC: Time-based Helix test scheduling with AzDO history #54939
  • Fix Mark of the Web detection by removing MUTZ_ISFILE flag #54937
  • [StaticWebAssets] Replace opaque endpoint-manifest collision throw with a targeted BLAZOR107 diagnostic #54934
  • [Experiment] Combine CI Build and Queue Tests into a single invocation #54933

Merged

  • Use native, `leaveOpen` tar streaming to decompress the tar without copy #54757
  • Migrate Microsoft.NET.Sdk.BlazorWebAssembly.Tests to MSTest.Sdk on MTP #54861
  • Include resolved tool version in invalid DotnetToolSettings install/update errors #54822
    cli-ux
  • Remove unnecessary data point in `dotnetup` #54946
  • add `ci`, `output_directed`, `llm` label to `dotnetup` dashboard #54663
  • don't let `dotnetup` failure count as a install script failure #54756
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Migrate dotnet-watch.Tests to MSTest.Sdk on MTP #54903

Updated

  • Allow `dotnetup` to handle when a release has no archives but has sys installers #54910
  • [automated] Merge branch 'main' => 'release/dnup' #54788
    Area-AspNetCore, sdk-diagnostic-docs-needed

  • Migrate Microsoft.NET.Sdk.BlazorWebAssembly.AoT.Tests to MSTest.Sdk on MTP #54862
  • File-based apps: recognize more logger arguments #54637
